shellCommands.command: git status --short && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100 && cat package.json && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/
cat app/page.tsx app/product/page.tsx lib/data.ts app/layout.tsx next.config.ts; echo ---; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -80
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs && grep -ril "prefetch" . | head -30; echo ---; ls 01-app/01-getting-started 01-app/02-guides 2>/dev/null | head -80

cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app && ls 03-api-reference/04-functions/ | grep -iE "prefetch|navigation"; ls 03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/ | grep -i prefetch; ls 03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/*route-segment* 2>/dev/null | grep -i prefetch

cd /workspace && git diff package.json; grep -o '"version": "[^"]*"' node_modules/next/package.json; grep -n "unstable_prefetch\|unstable_navigation" node_modules/next/cache.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/use-cache/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "unstable_prefetch" node_modules/next/dist/server/web/spec-extension/*.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5
npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "tsc exit: $?"; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -40
